relaxation_boundary: top two Cu layers may relax; bottom Cu layer is constrained
coverage_definition: N_H/4, where four top-layer Cu atoms define 1 ML
site_definition: fcc hollow is the threefold site above a third-layer Cu atom; hcp hollow is above a second-layer Cu atom; bridge is midpoint of two top-layer Cu atoms; top is vertically above one top-layer Cu atom
